## Meeting Purpose

[Align on the client pricing proposal and internal development priorities.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=267.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Pricing Proposal:** Propose a new €2,000/mo minimum fee, justified by the project's scope expansion and high customization for Kassaj.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=297.0)
  - [**Distribution Page Redesign:** Prioritize a redesign to improve usability on tablets, addressing critical height constraints and making the scan history the primary focus.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1440.0)
  - [**E2E Testing:** Make building end-to-end (E2E) tests a top priority to prevent regressions and ensure features work correctly for all user roles (e.g., admin vs. kitchen).](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=61.0)
  - [**New Business Strategy:** Launch a landing page and explore new markets (offshore catering, government subsidies) to diversify revenue and reduce reliance on a single, highly customized client.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=103.0)

## Topics

### Client Pricing & Scope

  - [**Problem:** The project's scope has expanded significantly beyond the initial agreement, shifting from a general tool to a highly customized solution for Kassaj.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=637.0)
  - [**Justification for Price Increase:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=637.0)
      - [**Customization:** The tool is now deeply tailored to Kassaj's specific needs, requiring more development and maintenance effort.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=637.0)
      - [**Value Delivered:** The team has consistently over-delivered on features (QR codes, NFC) and speed, providing Kassaj with significant operational value.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=852.0)
      - [**Usage Growth:** Daily usage is growing (e.g., 68 orders, 48 meals delivered today), demonstrating the app's value and adoption.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=376.0)
  - [**Proposal:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=881.0)
      - [**Fee:** €2,000/month minimum.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=297.0)
      - [**Structure:** This fee includes 400 user seats (€5/seat). The price will scale with usage above this threshold.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=881.0)
      - [**Rationale:** This structure incentivizes Kassaj to roll out the app to more users, unlocking greater ROI for them and aligning with their stated corporate expansion plans (Germany, Gibraltar).](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=881.0)

### Development Priorities

  - [**End-to-End (E2E) Testing:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=61.0)
      - [**Problem:** Testing in the admin account fails to catch issues that affect other user roles.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=61.0)
      - [**Solution:** Build comprehensive E2E tests to ensure features work correctly for all users (e.g., kitchen staff).](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=61.0)
  - [**Distribution Page Redesign:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1440.0)
      - [**Problem:** The current layout is inefficient on tablets, lacking vertical space and burying the critical scan history.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1490.0)
      - [**Solution:** Redesign the page to prioritize the scan history and optimize space.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1490.0)
          - [Collapse the sidebar on tablets.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1589.0)
          - [Move KPIs below the header.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1724.0)
          - [Make the scan history scrollable within its own container.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1811.0)
          - [Reduce the size of user cards to save vertical space.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1863.0)
  - [**Error Handling:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=29.0)
      - [**Problem:** The current PostHog error handling lacks detailed stack traces.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=29.0)
      - [**Solution:** Improve error handling to provide better diagnostic information.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=29.0)

### New Business & Branding

  - [**Landing Page:** Adrian will build a landing page to support lead generation efforts.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1395.0)
  - [**Lead Generation Channels:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=103.0)
      - [**Cold Calling:** A friend is contacting other companies.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=103.0)
      - [**Government Subsidies:** Adrian's brother, who works for the Baden-Württemberg environmental agency (and will join the federal agency in January), will explore subsidy opportunities for the food waste reduction tool.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2199.0)
      - [**Offshore Catering:** This market is a strong fit due to its critical need for precise food planning.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2282.0)
  - [**Branding:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1949.0)
      - [**Problem:** The name "ByteClub" has a negative connotation in French-speaking markets.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1949.0)
      - [**Decision:** Defer a full rebrand. The immediate priority is securing the new pricing with Kassaj.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=1949.0)

### Infrastructure & Costs

  - [**AWS Amplify:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2472.0)
      - [**Cost:** \~$60/month, primarily driven by an EC2 instance running N8N and Coolify for experiments.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2576.0)
      - [**Credits:** The project has €1,000 in credits, which will be depleted in \~10 months at the current burn rate.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2576.0)
  - [**Vercel:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2373.0)
      - [**Usage:** CPU usage is at 75% of the hobby plan limit.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2418.0)
      - [**Upgrade Path:** A Pro plan (€20/month) may be needed to increase limits and enable team-wide branch deployments.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2534.0)
  - [**N8N:**](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2686.0)
      - [**Cost:** The self-hosted instance on AWS is the primary driver of infrastructure costs.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2576.0)
      - [**Alternative:** Consider switching to N8N's official hosting (€20/month) to reduce AWS spend and simplify management.](https://fathom.video/share/6MGsKHxe3Socqu9phYMsVLK6qgxRCqMN?tab=summary&timestamp=2738.0)
